items.note: Black current pill and underlined section links on the left, a lemon header band with breadcrumb and section-size title closed by an ink seam, then one white ink-framed panel with 48px ink inputs, a dashed avatar box and a pink save button. The page sits on paper and ends in the black subscribe footer. This is the reference's settings language (07) almost one to one. It is quieter than the reference only because the spec asks for no sticker on a non-overview screen.

Same build stacked for the phone: a horizontal pill row, the lemon band with a seam, one framed panel with full-width 48px fields and a full-width pink submit, and the black footer. The hairline character matches the reference phone screen (10). The section pill row has no left gutter and cuts its last item at the right edge.

Black ground with panels and inputs one step lighter, edged in the light hairline, so depth now reads the right way up. The lemon band is unchanged and the current pill turns white, as in the reference's dark capture (11). The earlier inverted-depth gap is closed here.

Black ground and a raised grey panel with light hairlines. The lemon band is unchanged and the current pill is white. The fields and the pink submit match the light build, so dark mode reads as the same system. The pill row cuts its last item at the edge, as in light mode.

A periwinkle header band carries a white outline status pill with a dot. Below it, two white ink-framed groups have a heading row and toggle rows divided by 1px ink rules, with pink-filled switches for on. This is the reference's ruled-panel and toggle look (07) with clean rhythm. Rows are a little tighter than the 56px row size but read well.

The band, status pill and ruled toggle groups stack cleanly at phone width. Descriptions wrap beside the switches without crowding, close to the reference's tidy phone chrome. The section pill row runs off the right edge and has no left gutter.

Raised grey groups on a black ground with light rules, and the periwinkle band unchanged. The status pill on the band keeps its white fill and ink text in dark, which fixes the earlier black-pill fault. Pink on-switches still read. Off-switches use a grey knob that is a little softer than ink.

Matches the light phone build: an unchanged periwinkle band with a white status pill, raised ruled groups on black, and pink and grey switches. The language is consistent with the reference's dark mode. The pill row is cut at the right edge.

A teal header band, a white ink panel for the password form with a pink submit, then an ink-framed sessions table with a paper header row, ruled rows and outline row actions. The chrome is faithful. The password fields stop at about half the panel width and leave its right half empty, where the reference (07) fills a panel with a left description column and full-width fields.

The teal band, a framed password panel with full-width fields and pink submit, and a sessions table that scrolls horizontally inside its ink frame. All of it follows the spec's phone rules and the reference's hairline density. The section pill row starts flush against the left edge with no gutter.

Correct dark depth: raised grey panel and table on black with light hairlines, and the teal band unchanged. The same half-width password fields leave the right half of the panel empty, which looks less composed than the reference's filled panels.

Matches the light phone build in dark: raised panel, full-width fields, pink submit and a scrolling ink-framed table, with the teal band unchanged. Faithful to the reference's dark chrome. The pill row again has no left gutter.

A marigold band, then three plan option cards with notched pink price flags, ink check discs and outline switch buttons. The current plan has the pink selected border, a pink check disc and a status pill. Below come a payment panel and an invoice table with one flag per amount and outline status pills. This is the strongest use of the system's signature pieces in the app, close to the reference's option cards (07).

Plan cards stack to one column with their flags and the pink selected border intact. The invoice table scrolls inside its frame. Everything below the band holds the reference's character. The current pill in the section row is cut by the right edge of the screen.

Raised grey plan cards on black, with flags and the pink selected border unchanged. Check discs turn light, and the invoice table rises correctly from the ground. Dark mode keeps the poster pieces exactly as the reference does (11).

Stacked raised plan cards with flags and the pink selected card, and a scrolling invoice table on black. This is a faithful dark phone build. The white current pill for this section is cut by the screen edge.

findings.summary: The password form's fields stop at about half the panel width and leave the right half of the white panel empty. The reference fills its settings panels, either with full-width fields or with a description column beside the controls, so the panel reads as one composed block. This was named in the earlier verdict and has not closed.

On phones the section pill row has no side gutter and overflows. The first item sits flush against the left edge, and the last item, often the current pill itself, is cut by the right edge with no scroll cue. The reference's phone chrome keeps its 16px gutter and shows the current pill whole.
